focus.title: 欧盟碳边境调节机制过渡期收官在即，中国出口企业须加速碳数据合规布局
focus.summary: 欧盟CBAM过渡期将于2026年底结束，2027年起进入正式征税阶段。中国钢铁、铝、化肥等行业出口企业面临碳成本传导压力，需尽快建立产品碳足迹核算体系、完善供应链碳排放数据收集，并评估在欧盟境内设立合规实体的必要性。未雨绸缪者将获得绿色竞争力先机。
focus.source: 来源：欧盟委员会气候行动总司 · 2026.10.28
focus.title_en: EU CBAM Transitional Period Nears End: Chinese Exporters Must Accelerate Carbon Data Compliance
focus.summary_en: The EU's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) transitional period ends in late 2026, with definitive taxation starting in 2027. Chinese exporters in steel, aluminium, and fertilisers face carbon cost pass-through pressure. Companies should urgently establish product carbon footprint accounting, improve supply chain emissions data collection, and assess the need for an EU-based compliance entity. Early movers will gain a green competitive edge.

case.title: 新加坡国际仲裁中心案例：跨境合同中的多层争议解决条款效力获确认
case.summary: 近期SIAC一则裁决确认，约定“协商-调解-仲裁”多层争议解决条款有效，当事人未完成前置程序即提起仲裁可能被驳回。该案提示中国出海企业在起草跨境合同时，应明确前置程序的时限、启动方式及未履行的后果，避免争议解决条款因模糊而失效或引发管辖权异议。
case.source: 来源：新加坡国际仲裁中心案例摘要 · 2026.10
case.title_en: SIAC Case: Validity of Multi-Tiered Dispute Resolution Clauses in Cross-Border Contracts Confirmed
case.summary_en: A recent SIAC award upheld a multi-tiered dispute resolution clause requiring negotiation, mediation, and arbitration, suggesting that parties may have claims dismissed if they commence arbitration without completing pre-arbitral steps. Chinese outbound enterprises should specify time limits, initiation methods, and consequences of non-compliance in such clauses to avoid ambiguity and jurisdictional challenges.

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区推出跨境数据流动便利化新举措，企业合规路径进一步明晰
policy.summary: 广东省近日发布大湾区跨境数据流动便利化试点指引，明确科研、金融、医疗等场景下数据出境的安全评估与备案流程，并探索“白名单”机制。企业应借此梳理数据资产、完善内部合规制度，利用试点政策降低跨境传输合规成本，同时关注个人信息保护与重要数据识别的边界。
policy.source: 来源：广东省政务服务数据管理局 · 2026.10
policy.title_en: Greater Bay Area Introduces New Measures to Facilitate Cross-Border Data Flows, Clarifying Compliance Pathways
policy.summary_en: Guangdong Province recently issued pilot guidelines for facilitating cross-border data flows in the Greater Bay Area, clarifying security assessment and filing procedures for data exports in research, finance, and healthcare, and exploring a whitelist mechanism. Enterprises should map data assets, improve internal compliance, leverage pilot policies to reduce costs, and monitor boundaries between personal information protection and important data identification.
policy.source_en: Source: Guangdong Provincial Government Services and Data Management Bureau · Oct 2026

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国对外投资审查新规下，中国企业的技术合作与架构安排需审慎
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国对外投资审查规则持续收紧，涉及半导体、人工智能等敏感领域的跨境投资与技术合作面临更高门槛。建议中国企业：一是在交易前开展投资目的地审查风险评估；二是优化交易架构，避免触发强制申报义务；三是完善技术出口内部合规体系，保留完整决策记录以备核查。
analysis.source: 来源：美国财政部投资安全办公室 · 2026.10
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: Chinese Firms Must Exercise Caution in Tech Cooperation and Deal Structuring under New US Outbound Investment Rules
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: US outbound investment screening rules continue to tighten, raising barriers for cross-border investment and technology cooperation in sensitive sectors such as semiconductors and AI. Chinese companies should: (1) conduct pre-transaction risk assessments of investment destinations; (2) optimise deal structures to avoid mandatory filing triggers; (3) strengthen internal compliance for technology exports and maintain complete decision-making records for verification.
analysis.source_en: Source: US Department of the Treasury, Office of Investment Security · Oct 2026
